description.shortText: An elevated mass transit system designed for dense urban corridors in which a vehicle straddles the width of two road lanes, bypassing traffic congestion. The electric-powered vehicle has the capacity to replace up to 40 conventional buses and overall has improved energy efficiency.

attachments.name: China electric straddling bus: PHOTOS, FEATURES - Business Insider
attachments.description: The straddling bus, which was developed by the Chinese company Transit Explore Bus, makes traffic jams obsolete.

attachments.name: China's 'straddling bus' hits its final roadblock - BBC News
attachments.description: It seemed like a vision of the future - but China's "straddling bus" is being scrapped for good.
